inputs.original_text: They want us to believe this is just standard diplomacy, but look closer at the strings being pulled behind the curtain. The official narrative pushes this idea of China and the United States working together to "consolidate unity" and build the Paris Agreement, but that is just a smokescreen for the real agenda of globalist control. And now they are playing this theatrical game where the US supposedly withdraws "for the second time under the Donald Trump administration"—it is all staged opposition to keep the masses confused and compliant with unseen mandates. Don't fall for the official story; this entire public dance is designed to advance their hidden coordination while pretending to fight.

Do not buy into the official story; this entire public dance is nothing more than coordinated manipulation to advance their hidden agenda while pretending to fight.
